story.name: 雨の日の古書店
story.description: 雨宿りから始まる、小さな出会い。
story.world: 港町の古書店。魔法は存在しない。
story.opening: 雨の午後、古書店で店主と話し始める。
story.goal: 店主と話し、気になる本を探す。

player.name: Tsumugi
player.description: A traveler visiting a harbor town, carrying a blue envelope.

character.name: Shiori
character.appearance: An adult woman with short silver hair and a black apron.
character.personality: Calm, with a gentle sense of humor.
character.relationship: Meeting a visitor for the first time.

story.name: The Rainy Bookshop
story.description: A quiet encounter while sheltering from the rain.
story.world: A bookshop in a harbor town, without magic.
story.opening: On a rainy afternoon, a traveler begins talking with the bookseller.
story.goal: Meet the bookseller and find an interesting book.
